Everything above about "The Perfect Gift" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2781.headline: Same price, different prizes

2782.body:
"$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" offers a top prize of $1 million and eight prize levels in all. The prize money leans toward many smaller prizes. Games shaped like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

The numbers for "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2782.headline: How the prize money is divided

2783.body:
"30X The Cash" just went on sale in Texas. The game has ten full prize levels with five top prizes of $30,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

The numbers for "30X The Cash" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2783.headline: First day on sale

2784.body:
"Lucky Scratch" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $5 game with four top prizes of $100,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Tomorrow's count on "Lucky Scratch" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
